Contract CoCoMESystem::openCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashDesks: Set(CashDesk) = CurrentStore.AssociationCashdeskes
	precondition:
		cashDesks->exists(cashDesk|cashDesk.Id = cashDeskID and
		cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentStore.IsOpened = true and
		CurrentCashDesk = cashDesk and
		cashDesk.IsOpened = false)
	postcondition:
		cashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		result = true
}
